title: Bell-state reference contract
purpose: Exercise the local experiment, policy, simulator, baseline, and receipt contracts without network or QPU access.
hypothesis: The reference subset simulator produces only 00 and 11 outcomes with equal exact probability for H(0) followed by CX(0,1).
stop_conditions: Any outcome other than 00 or 11 has non-zero exact simulator probability.
The receipt reports a network call, non-zero QPU time, non-zero queue time, or non-zero cost.
The run is labelled above E0.
limitations: The Bell-state fixture is educational and does not test a useful application.
Agreement with an analytic two-qubit result does not validate a production simulator.
